## OpenRSVP v1.10.0

This release expands platform administration and makes deployment controls safer and more explicit.

### Highlights

- Added an admin-managed organizer signup policy. Super admins can enable or disable public organizer registration from **Admin → Settings** without rerunning setup or restarting OpenRSVP.
- Added independent, opt-in email notifications to active super admins when a new organizer is created or an account is promoted to admin or super admin.
- Fixed unreadable native role-selector options in Chrome dark mode.
- Corrected landing-page GitHub links to point to [IanWardell/openrsvp](https://github.com/IanWardell/openrsvp).
- Protected the instance Settings route so regular admins cannot render or modify super-admin settings.
- Hardened CI and release promotion with required checks, container smoke testing, protected branches, release-candidate images, immutable tag-driven releases, provenance, and SBOM metadata.

### Container tags

The release publishes `1.10.0`, `1.10`, `1`, `latest`, and a commit-specific `sha-*` tag to `ghcr.io/ianwardell/openrsvp`.

### Historical image note

Before this release, the branch-driven publishing workflow republished the `1.9.0` container tag from commit `0cc7194`, while Git tag `v1.9.0` identifies commit `ed0b76a`. The historical `1.9.0` image is therefore mutable and does not provide tag-to-image reproducibility. This release fixes forward: beginning with `v1.10.0`, semantic-version container tags are created only from matching annotated Git tags and existing version tags are never overwritten.
